dosage_and_administration: Directions for Use: Place globules under tongue for 30 seconds. Adults~3-5 globules 3 times a day. Children 2-12 years ~ 1-3 globules 3 times a day. Under 2 years, consult your doctor. Use until symptoms are relieved or as directed by your health care provider.
pregnancy_or_breast_feeding: If pregnant or breastfeeding ask a health professional before use.
do_not_use: TAMPER EVIDENT: Do not use if safety seal is broken before first use.
indications_and_usage: Use: Calming effects. For temporary relief of spasms. May also be used for standard homeopathic indications or as directed by your physician.
active_ingredient: Chamomilla 30X, HPUS The letters HPUS indicate that these ingredients are officially included in the Homeopathic Pharmacopoeia of the United States.
